headline: Lower gas output trims profit; costs and capex beat

kpis.label: Free cash flow attributable to EQT

summary_short: Adjusted EPS fell to $0.42 from $0.52 as sales volume dropped 8% to 583 Bcfe, including 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments. Capex of $638M came in 10% below the low end of guidance.
summary_long: Realized price slipped to $2.72 per Mcfe from $2.76; the differential of $(0.64) was favorable to guidance on marketing optimization. Operating costs rose to $1.09 per Mcfe, at the low end of guidance. Free cash flow attributable to EQT was $283M and net debt was just under $5.5B, down from $7.7B at year end. EQT announced the acquisition of Range Resources and raised the dividend 3% to $0.68 annualized. Q4 volume is guided to 550-600 Bcfe.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow are non-GAAP measures as defined by EQT. Volume y/y computed from 583 vs 634 Bcfe stated in the release. Full-year 2026 guidance table was not captured in detail.

drivers.explanation: Includes 21 Bcfe of strategic curtailments during the quarter amid lower natural gas prices.
Higher gathering, transmission (lower volume) and SG&A (long-term incentive and professional service costs) per Mcfe, though total sat at the low end of guidance.
Differential was favorable to guidance thanks to marketing optimization and the curtailment strategy, despite widening basis.
CEO says marketing drove stronger realized pricing, expenses landed at the low end of guidance and capital spending was well below expectations.
